name: experienced_backend_ic
description: The common case: a mid-level backend engineer with real metrics, applying to an adjacent stack. Baseline for every other fixture.
jd_text:
Senior Backend Engineer

We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own our payments platform.

What you'll do:
- Own end-to-end delivery of payment processing services
- Design and scale distributed systems handling high transaction volume
- Partner with product on roadmap prioritisation
- Mentor engineers on system design and code quality

Requirements:
- 5+ years building production backend services
- Strong Python and PostgreSQL
- Experience with Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines
- Familiarity with event-driven architecture and Kafka

Nice to have:
- Go
- Experience in fintech or payments

resume_content.headline: Backend Engineer
resume_content.summary: Backend engineer with six years building transactional services for high-traffic consumer products.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
bullets: Built the order fulfilment API in Python, cutting average order processing time from 800ms to 240ms
Migrated the checkout database from MySQL to PostgreSQL with zero downtime across 4M records
Set up automated deployment pipelines that reduced release time from 2 hours to 15 minutes
Worked with the product team to plan quarterly engineering priorities
Helped newer engineers with code reviews and design feedback

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Developed internal reporting tools used by 40 people across three departments
Fixed a recurring data sync bug that had caused 12 incidents in six months
